verdict.rationale: Meta publishes model cards and benchmark claims (e.g., Llama3 70B vs Claude/Gemini) but provides no visible eval harness, exact prompts, or settings for reproduction, and community evidence directly disputes benchmark comparability — Meta reportedly used an 'experimental chat version optimized for conversationality' on LMArena, and users note omitted comparisons against GPT-4/Claude Opus, undermining auditability of the claims. Missing for 10: published eval harness/code, exact prompts and sampling settings for each cited benchmark, and a public accounting of the LMArena experimental-version discrepancy.
